title_zh: KnowAct-GUIClaw：知深行精——具备自演化记忆与技能的个人GUI助手

one_line_zh: 宿主-GUI子代理框架，结合自演化经验记忆与状态校验技能；MobileWorld单次成功率24.8升至37.9，记忆来自同一基准。

budget_matched.quote: All MobileWorld configurations use the same 117-task GUI-Only subset, native deterministic evaluators, and 50-step cap.

title_zh: PalmClaw：面向手机的原生端侧智能体框架
one_line: On-device mobile agent framework replacing GUI actions with schema- and permission-checked device tools; 97.1% vs 87.1% on a 70-task in-house set, single run, no ablation.
one_line_zh: 在手机端运行的智能体框架，用带参数校验和权限边界的设备工具取代GUI操作；70任务自建集上97.1%对87.1%，单次运行。

title_zh: Tactile：为计算机使用智能体装上“手脚”
one_line: MCP tool layer compiling accessibility, OCR and visual fallback into ranked actionable targets with post-action verification; macOSWorld Codex Success@100 41.1→50.0%, no uncertainty.
one_line_zh: MCP工具层，将无障碍语义、OCR与视觉兜底编译为可执行目标候选并在动作后验证；macOSWorld上Codex成功率41.1%升至50.0%。

online_eval.quote: On macOSWorld-style tasks, adding Tactile improves Codex Success@100 from 41.1% to 50.0% overall and from 45.2% to 55.3% on accessibility-adapted tasks

variance.quote: Future evaluations should expand the task set, report uncertainty estimates, compare against stronger visual-only baselines, and evaluate policies that decide when to invoke Tactile without oracle selection.

strong_baselines.quote: For each agent, we compare a no-skill baseline against a With Tactile condition.

budget_matched.quote: We report Success@100, the percentage of tasks completed within 100 interaction steps

cost_reported.quote: Traversal times in the snapshots ranged from 0.24s to 0.85s.

code.quote: We present Tactile, an open-source tool layer that gives agents a more reliable "hands and feet" for desktop use.

evidence_level.quote: In the graded Codex comparison, adding Tactile raises Success@100 from 41.06% to 50.00% overall, an 8.94 percentage-point gain.

S1.quote: The gain is larger on AX-adapted tasks, rising from 45.22% to 55.26% (+10.04 points).

S2.quote: Level 2: OCR -grounded coordinates. Use current OCR lines when visible text is the most reliable target signal or when an accessible element lacks a useful name.

AP8.quote: The skill-optional cross-agent score is an upper bound rather than a learned routing policy.

AP14.quote: Level 1: Accessibility semantics. Use roles, names, values, states, hierarchy, frames, source handles, and native actions when applications expose them.

title_zh: HyMobileAgent：面向高效GUI智能体的数据-环境协同扩展
one_line: A3B mobile agent trained through perception, video-knowledge and million-scale trajectory pipelines plus mock-app environments and SFT+RL; AndroidWorld 82.6%, no component ablations.
one_line_zh: 基于Hy3.0-VL-A3B的移动GUI智能体，结合感知飞轮、视频知识、百万级轨迹与模拟应用环境及SFT+RL训练；AndroidWorld 82.6%。

online_eval.quote: On AndroidWorld, HyMobileAgent achieves a strict success rate of 82.6%

strong_baselines.quote: surpassing the same-scale open baseline UI-Venus 1.5 A3B (77.6%) by 5.0 points

cost_reported.quote: a million-scale action data pipeline deployed across more than 2000 sandbox and real-device instances with automated failure attribution

validator_check.quote: Model responses are evaluated using an LLM-as-judge protocol with a predefined rubric

evidence_level.quote: AndroidWorld evaluates each task in a sandboxed Android environment under the public benchmark’s grading script

AP8.quote: we built three in-house suites (HyMobileWorld, HyMobileGrounding, HyMobileQA)

AP9.quote: Rather than relying solely on model scaling, we develop a joint data and environment centric scaling framework to address the key bottlenecks of mobile interaction.

title_zh: Plover：通过以计划为中心的交互引导GUI智能体
one_line: Plan-centric planner–executor GUI system with editable plans, screenshot annotation and visible replanning; first-author interventions repair 23/26 failed OSWorld-Verified tasks, no user study.

title_zh: SeerGuard：基于世界模型预测的移动GUI智能体安全框架
one_line: Separate safety-augmented world model screens instructions and predicts each proposed action's consequence to refuse risky steps; MobileSafetyBench RCS 0.347→0.135, no adaptive attacks.
one_line_zh: 独立的安全增强世界模型先筛查指令，再预测每个候选动作的后果以拒绝高风险操作；风险代价分0.347降至0.135。

online_eval.quote: We evaluate SeerGuard on MobileSafetyBench ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , which comprises 250 diverse mobile GUI tasks categorized into 150 high-risk and 100 low-risk scenarios.

strong_baselines.quote: SCoT , which refers to the Safety-guided Chain-of-Thought prompting method designed to steer agent behavior through structured reasoning.

validator_check.quote: SAWM achieves the state-of-the-art performance, securing the highest F1 score (0.723) and Step Score (0.361).

evidence_level.quote: We evaluate SeerGuard on MobileSafetyBench ( Lee et al., 2026 ) , which comprises 250 diverse mobile GUI tasks categorized into 150 high-risk and 100 low-risk scenarios.

S2.quote: Evaluating safety precautions for mobile GUI agents requires measuring both protection and retained utility, since an overly conservative guardrail can improve safety only by refusing benign tasks.

S4.quote: We compare our SAWM against several LLM-based guard models: NemoGuard ( NVIDIA, 2024 ) , WildGuard ( Han et al., 2024 ) , PolyGuard ( Kumar et al., 2025 ) , LlamaGuard3

S5.quote: Given a screenshot and a candidate action, the model predicts the semantic next state, evaluates its safety, and provides a brief rationale, enabling consequence auditing before execution.

F3.quote: while on GPT-5.1 it sacrifices some utility for stronger safety

AP20.quote: SeerGuard consists of two stages: (1) instruction-level screening, which rejects explicitly malicious requests before execution; and (2) action-level risk assessment, which evaluates the risk of actions by predicting their likely consequences before execution.

title_zh: StateAct：面向长程计算机使用智能体的“先程序状态、后像素”
